observations.why: Imperative directive enacting authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what the collective record must retain.
Imperative command to purge specific information from the shared record — authority-ranking enacted through directive control over collective knowledge.

Speaker asserts a corrective fact about institutional history from a position of authority over the record, overriding prior claims — authority-ranking enacted through epistemic control rather than command.
